## What's new

- **The Tiles panel remembers your library** (#13). The library you pick in the Tiles panel stays picked when you switch between Floors, Walls, Shadows, Objects, Roofs and Special. If it has no tiles for the layer you switch to, the panel shows all libraries there and goes back to yours on a layer it has tiles for. Opening another map still starts with all libraries.
- **Hide objects, and leave them out of copies** (#14). The layer bar above the map has a new **Objects** button. Switched off, objects and NPCs aren't drawn (markers, sprites and paths), and copying, cutting or clearing an area leaves them where they are. The message says how many were left out. The Objects tool still shows them, and Backspace (show every layer) turns them back on.
